hooks.text: 战场捡来的躯干、腿、臂架和模块可随时重装机甲
hooks.excerpt: Between battles, players can swap out parts for upgrades found on the battlefield and manage their campaign by taking on loans to afford ammunition, aiding the locals for support in battle and more. Equip devastating melee weapons such as swords, rocket spears and pile bunkers. Wield powerful long range guns like cannons, machine guns, flamethrowers and rocket pods. Mix and match armaments to suit your play style. Mix torsos, legs, armatures and special modules to customize your Granvir.

hooks.text: 弹药不够就借贷，还能帮助当地人换取战场支援
hooks.excerpt: Players battle through a route of their choice reaching extraction and completing side objectives at the cost of valuable resources. Between battles, players can swap out parts for upgrades found on the battlefield and manage their campaign by taking on loans to afford ammunition, aiding the locals for support in battle and more.

hooks.text: 最多10台Granvir联机，并在休息区共享零件与资源
hooks.excerpt: Complete any campaign in single-player or multiplayer co-op with up to 10 Granvir pilots at a time. Share parts and resources utilizing the squad depot in rest areas as you plan your next moves.
